answer: Payment escrows at submit and releases on grade. The panel must span three unrelated clusters or the payment voids. Rewards vest over 100 epochs. Numbers: 1 escrow, 3 clusters, 100 epochs of vesting. A farm that grades itself fails the diversity check and voids its own payout. A glacier of vested rewards sits unreachable behind a garden of clusters it cannot join. The velvet is the panel; cut it and the payment is gone.
